title: Shared store: runtime\<game-id>.json
description: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Wheelkit\store\runtime\<game-id>.json: one game's runtime settings, the values its F6 panel changes. Only that game's mod writes it. Files only gain fields and readers ignore fields they do not know (docs/STORE.md).

Schema.description: Always 1. It never changes: the file only gains fields.

Game.description: The game's dbce-mod.json id; also the file name.

Profile.description: The profile Id the game used when these values were saved. A value that starts from the profile (FFB strength) applies only while the game still uses this profile.

Values.description: F6 row id (the game's dbce-mod.json settings rows) to its value, in file order. Readers skip values of other types.
